title: Model B · an inner opera
text: I feel the warmth. I keep a little light. I see a face like mine. I long to go beyond. I learn to let things grow. I wait for you.

phrases.intention: A small rise, then a low settling note on warmth.
A familiar low opening opens upward into a held light.

phrases.text: I see a face like mine.
phrases.intention: The lamp high note turns inward, descending to an unresolved F-sharp.
Growing steps lead to a sustained high B on the last syllable of beyond.

phrases.text: I learn to let things grow.
phrases.intention: A descending opening makes space for a gentle rise into grow.
Wait is held, then a small rise out of low D settles on you.

perspective: The player is Care Unit Model B. Objects prompt first-person sung thoughts in the player’s own inner voice. Objects do not speak as separate characters.
delivery: Dry centred mono, no room reverb, no world-position pan. Designed as an inner-voice study; no headphone or headset listening claim.
runtime_scope: Native Godot renders and browser object audition. VR gaze/proximity bindings are proposed metadata, not a shipped VR scene.

trigger_design.mode: deliberate object selection in browser prototype
trigger_design.game_proposal: Intentional gaze or touch, one thought at a time, do not repeat until the player leaves and returns.
